name: ChatGPT
tagline: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship conversational AI, capable of answering questions, drafting documents, writing and explaining code, analysing data, and generating images. Powered by GPT-4o, it remembers context across a conversation and can read files, browse the web, and run code inside a sandbox. With over 200 million weekly active users, it's the most widely used AI assistant in the world.
